text: EdgeConneX is owned by EQT's infrastructure funds: EQT Infrastructure has owned the company since 2020, and after selling a minority stake to Sixth Street-managed funds in 2024 EQT Infrastructure remained its largest shareholder.
short: EdgeConneX is owned by EQT's infrastructure funds; EQT remains its largest shareholder, Sixth Street holds a minority.

source.name: Sixth Street newsroom: EQT Welcomes Sixth Street as Strategic Investor in EdgeConneX
source.quote: Having been invested in the company since 2020, EQT Infrastructure will remain the largest shareholder following the closing of the transaction.

additionalSources.name: EdgeConneX press release: EdgeConneX Announces Completion of its Acquisition by EQT Infrastructure
additionalSources.note: Confirms the acquisition closed on 2020-11-05. EdgeConneX's site blocks scripts (403 to the CI checker), but this researcher opened the page and read the text.
additionalSources.quote: announced today that its acquisition by EQT Infrastructure from an investor group led by Providence Equity Partners has closed
